legal.lastUpdated: Last updated: August 2026. Standard enterprise usage and copyright licensing terms.
legal.compliance1Text: All video scripts, storyboard frames, and rendered short dramas produced through Shine Studio AI are licensed for commercial distribution on TikTok, Meta Reels, YouTube Shorts, and DramaBox ecosystems without royalties.
legal.compliance2Text: Users must comply with regional copyright regulations and refrain from generating non-consensual deepfakes, violent content, or infringing intellectual properties.
legal.compliance3Text: Voice cloning data and generated character LoRA anchors are stored in private S3/GCS buckets and are never shared across tenant accounts.
legal.privacy1Text: Shine Studio collects essential project scripts, uploaded reference images, and generated audio files solely to facilitate AI rendering pipelines and cloud exports.
legal.privacy2Text: Prompts and reference media are securely transmitted to verified upstream inference providers (Google Gemini / Vertex AI, Veo 3, Freesound, Pixabay, Pexels) over encrypted TLS 1.3 connections.
